title: Everyday life: the colonial city, the plaza and the markets
goal: Read how colonial cities were planned around a plaza, and use frequency adverbs to say how often things happened.

items: Use *normalmente*, *a menudo*, *de vez en cuando* and *cada día* to say how often things happened.
Say what was at the centre of a colonial city.
Use the key words of city life: plaza, grid, market, resident and procession.
I can use *normalmente*, *a menudo*, *de vez en cuando* and *cada día* to say how often things happened.
I can say what was at the centre of a colonial city.
I can say what a tianguis was.
I can say where rich families lived.
I can use the key words of city life: plaza, grid, market, resident and procession.
